fusions.name: Carve and Serve
fusions.desc: Sweeps the tines round you, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and healing you for 20% of the damage dealt. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Scraped Plate
fusions.desc: Casts the tines out to scrape the target for 18 damage and heals you for 40% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Pick the Bones
fusions.desc: Gleans every body within 8 tiles, up to 5; each gives back 7% of your health.

fusions.name: Whetted Appetite
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, healing you receive rises by 40% for 8 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. Each kill also restores 3 health.
